returnsPolicy.OPENED_ITEMS.OUR_FAULT_ONL: Items must be unopened. Opened or used items are refunded only when the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.OPENED_ITEMS.UNOPENED_ONLY: Items must be unopened. Opened or used items aren't refunded.
returnsPolicy.NON_RETURNABLE_ITEMS.SOME: Some items can't be returned; they are marked as not returnable on your order.
returnsPolicy.RETURN_SHIPPING_FEE.FREE: Returns are free: there is no return shipping fee.
returnsPolicy.RETURN_SHIPPING_FEE.FLAT: A return shipping fee of {money} is deducted from your refund. It is waived when the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.RETURN_SHIPPING_FEE.FLAT_A: A return shipping fee of {money} is deducted from your refund.
returnsPolicy.RESTOCKING_FEE.PERCENT: A restocking fee of {percent}% of the item value is deducted. It is waived when the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.RESTOCKING_FEE.PERCENT_ALW: A restocking fee of {percent}% of the item value is deducted.
returnsPolicy.DELIVERY_REFUND.ALWAYS: If you return every paid item, the delivery fee is refunded too.
returnsPolicy.DELIVERY_REFUND.OUR_FAULT_: The delivery fee is refunded when every paid item comes back because the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.FREE_GIFT.DEDUCT_UNLESS_RE: If you return every paid item, please return the free gift too; otherwise its value is deducted from your refund.
returnsPolicy.FREE_GIFT.MUST_RETURN: If you return every paid item, the free gift must be returned with them.
returnsPolicy.FREE_GIFT.KEEP_FREE: You can keep a free gift, even if you return the paid items.
returnsPolicy.FREE_GIFT.DEDUCT_WHEN_NOT_: If the items you keep no longer qualify for a free gift's offer, please return the gift too; otherwise its value is deducted from your refund.
returnsPolicy.FREE_GIFT.MUST_RETURN_WHEN: If the items you keep no longer qualify for a free gift's offer, the gift must be returned with them.

returnsPolicy.EXCHANGES.AVAILABLE.one: You can request an exchange within {count} day of delivery.
returnsPolicy.EXCHANGES.AVAILABLE.other: You can request an exchange within {count} days of delivery.

returnsPolicy.EXCHANGE_PRICE.LIST_PRICE: Exchanging for the same item is an even swap. For a different item you pay today's price and get back what you paid for the old item; if your order had an offer that the items you keep no longer qualify for, that is taken into account as in a return. A free gift can only be exchanged for the same item.
returnsPolicy.EXCHANGE_PRICE.LIVE_OFFER_: Exchanging for the same item is an even swap. For a different item you pay today's price with any offers running today, and get back what you paid for the old item; if your order had an offer that the items you keep no longer qualify for, that is taken into account as in a return. A free gift can only be exchanged for the same item.
returnsPolicy.EXCHANGES.DISABLED: Online exchanges aren't available. Please contact customer service and we will help you.
returnsPolicy.REFUND_TIMING.ON_INSPECTIO: Your refund is issued once the returned items arrive and pass inspection.
returnsPolicy.REFUND_TIMING.STAFF_REQUES: Your refund is issued after the returned items arrive, pass inspection and our team confirms it.
returnsPolicy.REFUND_DESTINATION.STORED_: Refunds go back to how you paid: gift card first, then loyalty points, then your card or wallet.
returnsPolicy.REFUND_DESTINATION.CARD_FI: Refunds go back to how you paid: your card or wallet first, then gift card, then loyalty points.
returnsPolicy.REFUND_DESTINATION.PROPORT: Refunds go back to how you paid, split across your payment methods in proportion to what each paid.
returnsPolicy.EARNED_POINTS.NEGATIVE_BAL: Points you earned on returned items are taken back. If you've already spent them, your points balance can go below zero.
returnsPolicy.EARNED_POINTS.DEDUCT_FROM_: Points you earned on returned items are taken back. If you've already spent them, their value is deducted from your refund.
returnsPolicy.REDEEMED_POINTS.ORIGINAL_E: Points you paid with go back to your account with their original expiry date.
returnsPolicy.REDEEMED_POINTS.MARKET_EXP: Points you paid with go back to your account with a new expiry period starting the day they are returned.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE.FINAL_AFTER_INSPE: This is an estimate. The final amount is confirmed after we receive and inspect the items.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_OPENED_ITEMS.OUR_: The estimate assumes the items arrive unopened. Opened or used items are refunded only when the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_OPENED_ITEMS.NOT_: The estimate assumes the items arrive unopened. Opened or used items aren't refunded.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_FEES.WAIVED_OUR_F: No return fees apply because the return is our fault.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_FREE_GIFT.DEDUCTE: You're returning every paid item but keeping the free gift, so its value ({money}) is deducted.
The items you keep no longer qualify for the free gift, so its value ({money}) is deducted unless you return it too.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_OFFER.ADJUSTED: The items you keep no longer qualify for the offer you bought them with, so {money} of that offer is kept from your refund (you pay their full price).
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_OFFER.RESTORED: An earlier return kept part of an offer from your refund. With these items back, the offer no longer applies to what you keep, so {money} is added back.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.CHARGED: Your delivery was free because of what you ordered. What you keep no longer qualifies, so the delivery fee ({money}) is kept from your refund.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.RESTORED: An earlier return kept the delivery fee from your refund. With everything back, {money} is added back.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_SPENT_POINTS.DEDU: You've already spent {points} points earned on this order, so their value ({money}) is deducted.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.REFUNDED: Your delivery fee is refunded because every paid item is coming back.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.NO_FEE: There was no delivery fee on this order.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.ALREADY_: Your delivery fee has already been refunded.
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.NOT_FULL: The delivery fee is refunded only when every paid item is returned.
The delivery fee is refunded only when every paid item comes back because the return is our fault ({reasons}).
returnsPolicy.ESTIMATE_DELIVERY.REASON_N: The delivery fee is refunded only when the return is our fault ({reasons}).

returnsPolicy.CANCELLATION.WINDOW.one: You can cancel online within {count} minute of ordering for a full refund, delivery included. Any coupon, gift card or points you used are given back.
returnsPolicy.CANCELLATION.WINDOW.other: You can cancel online within {count} minutes of ordering for a full refund, delivery included. Any coupon, gift card or points you used are given back.

returnsPolicy.CANCELLATION.CONTACT: To cancel an order before it ships, please contact customer service. Any coupon, gift card or points you used are given back.
returnsPolicy.CANCEL_ITEMS.ALLOWED: In the same time you can cancel just some items: you get back what they cost. If what you keep no longer qualifies for an offer, a free gift or free delivery, that is taken into account as in a return, and a free gift that no longer applies is removed.
returnsPolicy.OFFERS_ON_RETURN.KEEP_PRIC: If you return part of a 'buy X get Y' or set offer, you get back what you paid for the returned items; the offer stays on what you keep.
returnsPolicy.OFFERS_ON_RETURN.RECALCULA: If you return part of a 'buy X get Y' or set offer, your refund is what you paid less the full price of any items you keep that no longer qualify.
If your order reached an offer's spend minimum (for example a discount over a set amount), the discount on what you keep stays, even if what you keep is below the minimum.
If a return takes what you keep below an offer's spend minimum, or to a lower tier, the discount the kept items no longer earn is kept from your refund.
If a return takes what you keep below an offer's spend minimum, or to a lower tier, the discount the kept items no longer earn is kept from your refund when it is {money} or more.
returnsPolicy.FREE_DELIVERY_ON_RETURN.KE: If your order had free delivery, it stays free even if you return some items.
returnsPolicy.FREE_DELIVERY_ON_RETURN.CH: If your order had free delivery because of what you bought and you return items so that what you keep no longer qualifies, the delivery fee is kept from your refund. It is not charged if the return is our fault or if everything comes back.
returnsPolicy.COUPON_ON_RETURN.RELEASE_O: A coupon can be used once. It is given back if your order is cancelled or can't be delivered, or if every paid item comes back because of our mistake; after other returns it stays used.
A coupon can be used once. It is given back if your order is cancelled or can't be delivered; after a return it stays used.
returnsPolicy.COUPON_ON_RETURN.KEEP_USED: A coupon can be used once. It is given back if your order is cancelled, or if a parcel comes back because of a courier problem; after a return it stays used.
returnsPolicy.OUR_FAULT.FULL_REFUND: If the return is our fault ({reasons}), nothing is deducted from your refund: no return fees and no free-gift charge, and delivery is refunded when every paid item comes back.
returnsPolicy.OUR_FAULT.NO_FEES: If the return is our fault ({reasons}), nothing is deducted from your refund: no return fees and no free-gift charge.
returnsPolicy.RTO.KEEPS_DELIVERY: If you refuse the delivery, or we can't deliver because of the address or your availability, we refund what you paid less the delivery fee.
returnsPolicy.RTO.KEEPS_DELIVERY_AND_CHA: If you refuse the delivery, or we can't deliver because of the address or your availability, we refund what you paid less the delivery fee and a return charge of {money}.
returnsPolicy.RTO.CHARGE_ONLY: If you refuse the delivery, or we can't deliver because of the address or your availability, we refund what you paid less a return charge of {money}.
returnsPolicy.RTO.FULL_REFUND: If a parcel comes back to us undelivered, you get back everything you paid.
returnsPolicy.RTO_FREE_DELIVERY.KEPT: If your order had free delivery, the delivery fee we waived is also deducted in these cases.
